name: tts_tool_resolve_max_text_length
notes: C port (tts_tool_ports.c::tts_resolve_max_text_length) implements only the override->FALLBACK rungs of LIVE's six-rung resolution (ElevenLabs model table, PROVIDER_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH table and command-provider lookup are unported). Gate walks providers OUTSIDE those tables so the shared rungs pin parity; table-backed providers are a documented divergence.
